challenges.text: Phase 5.2 lacks a fallback strategy for codex unavailability
challenges.rationale: Without a fallback, the entire critique pipeline blocks on a third-party CLI being installed and authenticated, which is an unstated dependency.

challenges.text: No mention of state.json schema migration
challenges.rationale: Schema fields evolve across versions; absent a migration path, users on older state files will hit unparseable JSON at first run.

challenges.text: Consider hash-based dedup instead of exact-match
challenges.rationale: Exact-match dedup misses near-duplicates that differ only in whitespace or capitalization, undercounting redundancy.
